tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshon yig lha mtshan shes ldan

mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dbang bsgyur dbang mdzad chos sku kun tu bzang*// gdung tshab bstan pa'i nyi ma rig 'dzin brgyad// kun gyi bcud 'chang slob dpon pad+ma la// sgo gsum dang ba'i ngang nas phyag bgyi'o// 'dir sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshon yig dang lha mtshan ni/ dang po skya thig man ngag lugs su yod pa ltar byas la/ gang dgos gsher thig gis mnan zin pa dang*/ tshon bkye ba ni/ dbus che mchog gi dkyil 'khor spyi ltar las/ dbus 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad khyams dang bcas pa la/ lte ba gru gsum dmar po/ dbus su tshom bu smug nag zla gam gsum mdzes tshon/ rtsibs bzhi sngon po la/ mdun g.yas rgyab g.yon rnams su tshom bu smug ser mthing ljang rnams rim bzhin dang*/ rtsibs mtshan mdzes tshon/ gru chad phyogs mdog /khyams phyogs mdog la tshom bu sngon po bcu/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ rtsig pa ljang gu/ 'dod snam dmar po/ pha gu ser po/ dra phyed nag po/ ba ku li sngon po/ mda' yab dkar po| ka ba phyogs mdog /ka rgyan mdzes tshon/ rta babs bzhi'i nang na sa chu me rlung*/ mig gsum phyogs mdog /rwa rtse mdzes tshon/ rdo ra phyogs mdog /'khor yug nang ma la pad+ma sna tshogs/ phyi mdzes tshon la tshom bu brgyad/ rdo rje'i gdung brgyad gzhi ma nag po/ rdo rje ser po rnams so| |yang dag gi dkyil 'khor dbus chos 'byung sngon po la tshom bu sngon po/ rtsibs bzhi dmar skya la tshom bu mdun nas mthing ser dmar ljang ba/ rtsibs mchan mdzes tshon/ khyams phyogs mdog la tshom bu sna tshogs bcu drug /sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma tshom bu nyer brgyad rnams so// gshin rje la dbus gru gsum dmar po la tshom bu ser po/ rtsibs bzhi la tshom bu mdun nas phyogs mdog bzhi/

khyams la tshom bu sna tshogs bcu gnyis/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs bco brgyad do| |rta mgrin la dbus gru gsum ljang skya la tshom bu dmar po/ rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu sna tshogs brgyad/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs nyer brgyad do// phur pa la dbus gru gsum la tshom bu ljang nag /rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas tshom bu dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu sngon po bcu/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog /rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs bcu drug go// ma mo rbod gtong la dbus gru gsum la tshom bu sngo skya/ rtsibs bzhi la tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu sna tshogs bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs brgyad cu rtsa brgyad do// rig 'dzin la dbus gru gsum la tshom bu dkar po/ rtsibs bzhi la tshom bu phyogs mdog bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu brgyad/ sgo bzhir tshom bu phyogs mdog /rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs nyer gcig go// 'jig rten mchod bstod la dbus gru gsum la tshom bu mthing nag /rtsibs bzhi la tshom bu mthing ga bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu mthing ga nyer gnyis/ sgo bzhi la tshom bu mthing ga bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu sna tshogs brgyad bkod do// dmod pa drag sngags la dbus gru gsum la tshom bu nag po/ rtsibs bzhi la tshom bu nag po bzhi/ khyams la tshom bu nag po brgyad/ sgo bzhir tshom bu nag po bzhi/ rtsig pa sogs sngar ltar la/ 'khor yug phyi ma la tshom bu nag po brgyad do// de nas rdo rje'i gdung gi phyi'i khyams chen nang ma la/

shar du tshom bu dkar po bdun/ lhor ser po bdun/ nub tu dmar po bdun/ byang du ljang gu bdun rnams bkod cing*/ rtsig pa kha dog lnga ldan/ 'dod snam dmar po la tshom bu bcu drug /pha gu ser po/ dra phyed rgyu ma'i lda ldi la tsit+ta'i pho long 'phyang ba/ ba ku li sngon po la lag pa'i mda' yab/ zhing chen gyi ka ba la ka rgyan phyogs mdog /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig ste/ nang nas gser ser po/ shar bu sngon po/ rin chen dmar po/ rmig pa ljang gu/ mun pa nag po/ wa raṇ+ḍa ser po/ mun pa nag po/ shar bu sngon po/ rin chen dmar po/ rmig pa ljang gu/ mda' yab dkar po la nag po'i pad+ma phyed pa/ rwa rtse phyogs mdog /rdo ra phyogs mdog /gu ṇa ha ri phyogs mdog /khyams chen phyogs mdog la/ phyogs re rer bkra shis rtags brgyad/ gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan rnams kyis phyug par bya'o// de nas bka' sdod kyi 'khor yug la tshom bu sna tshogs mdog stong phrag bdun dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma sna tshogs/ de'i phyir dur khrod kyi gzhi nag po la chu brgyad kyis phye ba/ de'i phyir 'khor lo ser po rtsibs stong phrag /de'i phyir gzhi ma dkar po la rdo ra sngon po/ de'i phyir me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas skor du 'bar ba bri'o// gong gi dkyil 'khor dgu la tshon yig tu ma thebs pa rnams ni mdzes tshon dang*/ tshon yig 'dir thebs pa thams cad ni 'di kho na ltar byas pas legs par 'grub cing*/ kha cig rang gi rig bzo dang shes rab kyis bzos zin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi man ngag thig tu khag 'dogs pa dag 'byung ba ni bstan pa'i phung 'dre dang ba ku li lta bu ste/ de dag ni ma yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa 'di'ang rang gi brjed byang du bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa nyang lugs kyi dbang sgrom dang*/ pra khrid dang*/ las byang*/ thig rtsa/ dbang bum sogs nas legs par btus te rang gi zin bris su bgyis pa lags te/
'di la nor 'khrul byung na bde 'dus zhi khro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol zhing*/ shes ldan bstan pa'i khur 'degs kun gyi phyag gi zlos gar bsgyur ba'i phyi mor gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
